g.text: Actual work and joint evidence verification

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526c7d

g.text: Two saved 6 s engineering conditions; only the declared network capacity differs. Original failures are retained.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #345368

g.text: Both cases: action completed 3.25 s; report 3.75 s; own recheck sampled 5 s and arrived 5.5 s.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #345368

g.text: All gates use arrived public evidence. The private evaluator extracts completed-run endpoints; no truth returns to dispatch.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526c7d

g.text: The healthy-network service was already fully delivered during this window. Verification is not a demonstrated service-restoration gain.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526c7d

g.text: Shared actual costs: work 2 person-s; travel 2 person-s; access 0.5 person-s; wait 0.5 person-s. Budget envelopes are separate.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526c7d

g.text: Original 180 registered trials unchanged. This is finite synthetic engineering qualification, not a policy-effect comparison or field calibration.
